name: Gyromast's Revenge
summary: Gelkak Gyromast seeks payback against the local murlocs who plundered his wrecked ship along the Darkshore coastline. To carry out his vendetta, the eccentric captain sends adventurers to reactivate his mechanical first mate, the Threshwackonator 4100.

sections.title: A Captain's Vendetta
sections.body: Stranded upon the misty strands of Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast refuses to accept defeat at the hands of the shore-dwelling murlocs. Having salvaged the pieces needed to fuel his schemes, the eccentric captain sets his sights on complete retaliation against the tribe and their chief. Rather than wading into the surf with cutlass in hand, Gelkak relies on heavy engineering to exact his vengeance, entrusting a winding key to any landlubber brave enough to handle his mechanical subordinate.

sections.title: The First Mate's Mutiny
sections.body: Gelkak's trusted first mate is no salty dwarf or sailor, but the Threshwackonator 4100—a clanking mechanical golem abandoned in the shallows south of the wreck. While wind-up automation promises an easy slaughter of the murlocs, this particular machine proves dangerously unreliable. Upon being wound up and led back to the captain, the construct suffers a catastrophic malfunction, mistaking its rescuer and creator for hostile targets and forcing a battle on the beach.

faq.answer: Gelkak's first mate is the Threshwackonator 4100, an automated mechanical golem resting on the coast south of the stranded captain's camp.

Gelkak's vessel was shipwrecked along Darkshore, and the native Greymist murlocs scavenged his belongings and harassed his surviving crew. Gelkak intends to use his golem to crush the tribe and their chief.

faq.q: What happens when you bring the Threshwackonator back?
faq.answer: Lead the first mate back to Gelkak after activating it with his key. Its behavior upon reaching the captain is discovered during the escort.

faq.q: What do I do with Gyromast's Key after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: The key activates the Threshwackonator. After the mission is finished, it has no further purpose.

faq.q: Where did Gelkak get the Threshwackonator?
faq.answer: The golem is part of the cargo and equipment salvaged from Gelkak's ill-fated voyage along northern Kalimdor, designed as heavy mechanical muscle for his crew.

faq.q: Does Gelkak give up after the golem is destroyed?
faq.answer: Gelkak's plans and his response to your work are revealed when you bring his first mate back.

angles.text: Gelkak's mechanical first mate shows how much a stranded captain relies on his engineering equipment.
Gnomes may recognize the winding key as a familiar means of activating a mechanical automaton.
Clearing out malfunctioning machinery and aggressive murlocs helps secure the coastline for Alliance travel between Auberdine and the lands to the south.
